prior_root_readme_ownership: First v3 migration requires root README to match the current v2 snapshot. Later v3 generations verify every owned prior output, reject unexpected or shrinking ownership, and preserve manual edits.
publication_mode: Local dry-run by default; explicit --publish only
old_pending_commit_rule: Resume the exact saved pending commit first. Claim current publication only when requested_readme_snapshot_in_commit is true; otherwise regenerate and retry the same wrapper once.
new_campaign_scope: Explicitly pinned Python sources and reviewed reporting code
Completed trial public result and receipt metadata
excluded: Model artifact bytes and learned parameter values

private_trial_artifact_verification.requirements: Result and receipt identities/configs match, status PASS, real_model_fits equals1, both metric folds exist, all private artifact bytes match their receipt hashes and result model hash matches. Private bytes are never added to public evidence.

novel_trial_policy: 12 deterministic transport settings; one primary-only fit per trial, no alpha optimization, same coefficients applied unchanged to recent. Protocol owns precise scientific acceptance gates.
comparison_policy: Protocol explicit comparison ID or nearest earlier same-family setting by number of config differences with ID tie break, never selected by score. Deltas require two completed results.
completion_policy: Controller execution status and terminal scientific result remain separate. CHECKPOINT_ONLY is incomplete, not candidate validation. Publication does not assert efficacy or official improvement.
history_policy: Preserve36groups and completed10h/22h/23kst rows, prior12JSON failures versus recovered diagnostics, previously exposed and overlapping periods, confidence intervals containing0 where recorded, and user-reported official feedback as unverified.
private_anchor_requirement: Before generation or publication, launch-ready marker and automation must pin this contract and source hashes. This contract does not hash itself. Engine/runtime scientific release is separate.
first_production_generation_gate: Satisfied by independent read-only check of12actual prepared configurations on2026-11-08T07:14:23Z; runtime and launch-ready freeze remain separate.
revision_reason: Parent requested visible late nonrecommendation, latest paired CI, configuration glossary and actual fit duration; actual protocol exposed a shared-validator publication source allowance missing from initial implementation. All changes precede launch-ready freeze.
completion_display_policy: README must show selected ID, recommendation, candidate ZIP path, latest W ratio/change and paired weekly95%CI. Export or format validation does not override NOT_RECOMMENDED; no qualifying recipe does not imply no individual period point improvement.
configuration_explanation_policy: Explain temporal/spatial conservation, shifts, global/cloud contexts, fixed±10cloud boundaries, budget cap and transfer_fraction; link newCAMPAIGN.
actual_fit_duration_policy: Use valid elapsed seconds, else timezone-aware receipt fit_finished_utc minus fit_started_utc; do not confuse controller wall interval with active fit time.
